Hi Ethan / Lara —

Thanks again for taking the time earlier. Quick recap from our side:

- Key blockers you called out: SOC2 evidence for data isolation, and a short ops handover runbook for on-call.

Next steps we agreed: a focused ops walkthrough (30 min) with engineering + SRE to walk the runbook and failover behavior. You had a calendar conflict during our call so I wanted to offer two compact options that our engineers can commit to at short notice:

1) Wed 26 May, 08:30–09:00 PT
2) Thu 27 May, 11:00–11:30 PT

If either works, reply with exactly "CONFIRM: <slot number>" (e.g. CONFIRM: 1) and I will lock the invite and add the runbook attachment. If neither works, tell me two 30-minute windows next week and we will prioritize.

Attaching: redwood_ops_runbook_v1.pdf (stub) — this is a short ops runbook we'll walk through; sections: failover, cache invalidation, and audit logs.

Thanks — Mateo
